## Follow-up: public LeBoard reliability case study + reproducibility bundle

Independent analysis of the Apache-2.0 dataset [`rogation/leboard-training-runs`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/rogation/leboard-training-runs) (revision `f25f8a7603fcca023d16694dd01b9cb8280741b8`) is now public:

- Case study: https://www.arisole.com/developers/leboard-case-study
- Reproducibility repo: https://github.com/stealthg0dd/arisole-leboard-reliability

Verified with `arisole-eval==0.1.2`: multi-task `per_task[].metrics.successes` lists parse to 500 episodes/run; because these files carry no per-episode seeds, **0.1.2 reports unpaired rates** (paired_episodes=0). Episode transition counts in the write-up are **exploratory** (position-within-task pairing) from the independent `analysis.py`, not claimed as seed-paired PASS_TO_FAIL by the published package.

Not an official LeRobot / LeBoard / Hugging Face partnership.
comments.author: stealthg0dd

comments.body:
## Fix published: `arisole-eval==0.1.3` (label-coverage gate evidence)

@manfromnowhere143 Thank you — we independently reproduced your constructed control on the published **0.1.2** wheel:

- 30 seed-matched pairs, 1 `PASS_TO_PASS`, 29 `INCOMPARABLE`
- `gate` used `paired_episodes=30` as the evidence denominator → `REVIEW`, process exit **0**

That was incorrect for a CI gate. **0.1.3** adopts your bounded correction (with explicit summary fields):

- `matched_episodes` = seed-matched rows (back-compat `paired_episodes`)
- `comparable_episodes` = fully labelled transitions only
- `incomparable_episodes` = unknown / `INCOMPARABLE`
- Evidence thresholds and `pass_to_fail_rate` use **labelled** pairs only
- Incomplete label coverage → `INSUFFICIENT_DATA` with rule `require_paired_success_labels`
- Default `fail_ci_on_insufficient_data=true` → exit **2**
- Complete-evidence `BLOCK` / `PASS` preserved; clear labelled regressions can still `BLOCK` even if some labels are missing (BLOCK outranks INSUFFICIENT_DATA)

Re-ran your script against PyPI **0.1.3**: outcome `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`, exit **2**.

Regression tests: `apps/arisole-eval/tests/test_gate_label_coverage.py` (partial labels, missing labels, complete PASS/BLOCK, 19 vs 20 boundary, unpaired multi-task, 6/30≠6/60, `fail_ci_on_insufficient_data` off). Full package suite: **32 passed**. LeBoard unpaired fixtures and bundled quickstart still expect `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`.

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/arisole-eval/0.1.3/
- Hub card: https://huggingface.co/stealthgod/arisole-eval
- Commit: https://github.com/stealthg0dd/strideiq/commit/fdebd57b0c3731f6a11334456138fab0bfbc5949

```bash
pip install 'arisole-eval==0.1.3'
```
comments.author: stealthg0dd
